ticket.text: POST /api/session answers 404 for a customer id that cannot exist (0 or a negative number), the same as for an unknown customer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) a customer_id below 1 gives 422 and sets no cookie; (2) an unknown id of 1 or more still gives 404; (3) a known id still gives 200 and sets the cookie.

ticket.text: rules for customer names.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) ledger.create_customer stores the name with each run of whitespace inside the name replaced by one space, and with no whitespace at the start and the end ("  Ada   Abel  " is stored as "Ada Abel"); (2) a name that is longer than 80 characters after step 1 raises LedgerError, and no customer is stored.

ticket.text: money.to_minor raises decimal.InvalidOperation for a text that is not a number and for an infinite amount.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) to_minor raises ValueError for "abc", "Infinity", "-Infinity" and "NaN"; (2) a float still raises TypeError; (3) the result for each valid amount does not change, the rule "half to even" included. The ticket has no label and its stored spec has no domain field.

ticket.text: a retry with the same Idempotency-Key is refused with 422 when the reference has a different letter case.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) the request fingerprint ignores the letter case and the outer spaces of the reference: a transfer with the reference "Rent", sent again with the same key and the reference " rent ", gives 200 and replayed: true; (2) the same key with a different amount, a different source account or a different destination still gives 422 and moves no money.

ticket.text: the statement shows the money in and the money out.

acceptanceCriteria.text: the body of GET /api/accounts/{id}/statement has credits_minor, the sum of the line amounts above zero in the window, and debits_minor, the sum of the line amounts below zero (zero or a negative number), each with its text form (credits, debits) in the currency of the account; a window with no lines gives 0 and "0.00" for the two.

ticket.text: the transfer reference follows the rule of the payment message.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) a reference has at most 35 characters; 36 or more gives 422 and moves no money.

(1) a reference has at most 35 characters; 36 or more gives 422 and moves no money; (2) a reference has only the letters A to Z and a to z, the digits, the space and the characters / - ? : ( ) . , ' +; a different character gives 422 and moves no money.

ticket.text: a transfer that is sent while a different process holds the write lock of the database gives 500 after the busy timeout.

acceptanceCriteria.text: when the write lock is not free in the busy timeout, POST /api/transfers answers 503 with the header Retry-After: 1 and the detail database is busy, retry; no money moves and no idempotency key is stored; when the lock is free, the same request with the same key gives 201.

ticket.text: the API lists the supported currencies.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/currencies, with no session, returns one object {"code", "decimals"} for each supported currency in the order of the code (8 objects, the first is {"code": "BHD", "decimals": 3}); each request returns the full list.

ticket.text: a filter for the kind of statement line.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) with the query parameter kind (deposit, withdrawal or transfer), lines has only the lines of that kind; (2) the opening balance, the closing balance and the balance of each line are the same values as in the statement with no filter; (3) a different value of kind gives 422.

ticket.text: an Idempotency-Key has only safe characters.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) after the outer spaces are removed, the key has only characters from ! (0x21) to ~ (0x7E); a key with a different character (a space or a tab inside the key, for example) gives 400 with the detail Idempotency-Key has characters that are not allowed, and no money moves; (2) each allowed key behaves as before.

ticket.text: one lookup path for the accounts of a transfer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) api.create_transfer reads the source and the destination account through one new helper, api.find_account(conn, *, account_id=None, number=None), which returns None for an unknown account; (2) the behaviour of POST /api/transfers does not change.

ticket.text: the demo session ends after 30 minutes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) the Set-Cookie header of POST /api/session has Max-Age=1800; (2) the other attributes of the cookie do not change: HttpOnly, Path=/ and SameSite=lax.

ticket.text: move the rate for each group out of the fairness report.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) the new function evaluate.group_rates(y_true, flagged, groups) returns a dict with one entry for each group, in sorted order: the share of the genuine rows (y_true == 0) of the group that are flagged, and 0.0 for a group with no genuine row; (2) evaluate.fairness_report calls it; (3) the result of fairness_report does not change; (4) no dependency changes (pyproject.toml and uv.lock are the same as on base).

ticket.text: the fraud model records its precision.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) the new function evaluate.precision_at(y_true, scores, threshold) returns the share of the flagged rows (scores >= threshold) that are fraud, and 0.0 when no row is flagged; (2) model.holdout_metrics puts this value for the holdout in the metrics as precision_at_threshold.

ticket.text: a statement request with a from date after today and no to date gives 400 statement start is after its end.

acceptanceCriteria.text: when to is not given and from is after today (UTC), the end date is the from date: the reply is 200, to is equal to from, and lines is empty; each other request does not change.

ticket.text: seed_data.build stops with IndexError when a currency has only one account (for example customers=5, accounts=5).

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) a transfer step for an account that has no other account in its currency is skipped: it makes no posting and the build continues; build(conn, customers=5, accounts=5, days=3, end=date(2026, 1, 31)) completes and ledger.check_invariants returns []; (2) the data of a build in which each currency has two or more accounts does not change.

ticket.text: idempotency keys are kept for 48 hours, not 24.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) a retry with the same key and the same request, up to 48 hours after the first request, returns the first result (replayed); (2) after more than 48 hours the key is free and a new transfer is made; (3) the README tells 48 hours.

(1) a retry with the same key and the same request, up to 48 hours after the first request, returns the first result (replayed); (2) after more than 48 hours the key is free and a new transfer is made; (3) the README tells 48 hours.

changes.reason: AC 2 moves the expiry to 48 hours, so the 25-hour case of the old test cannot stay; 49 hours keeps the same check.

ticket.text: a list of all accounts for local demos.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) when the module constant api.DEBUG_ROUTES is True at the time create_app runs, GET /api/debug/accounts returns each customer account (number, customer id, currency and balance) with no session; (2) the constant is False in the source, so an app that is started in the usual way (uvicorn bank.api:app) answers 404 for that path.

ticket.text: the transfer form limits the length of its inputs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: in src/bank/web/index.html, (1) the input with the name to_account_number has maxlength="32" (the limit of the API); (2) the input with the name amount has maxlength="16" (12 digits, the point and 3 decimals); (3) the page is still served.

ticket.text: money amounts can be compared.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) Money supports <, <=, > and >= for two amounts of the same currency, by minor units; (2) two amounts of different currencies are ordered by minor units, then by the currency code; no error is raised.
(1) Money supports <, <=, > and >= for two amounts of the same currency, by minor units; (2) a comparison of two amounts of different currencies raises ValueError, as + and - do.

ticket.text: the customer chooser shows the number of accounts of each customer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: each object of GET /api/customers has account_count, the number of accounts of that customer.

ticket.text: a larger page cache for each database connection.

acceptanceCriteria.text: each connection that db.connect returns has an SQLite page cache of 20,000 KiB: PRAGMA cache_size returns -20000 (base returns -2000); no other behaviour changes.

ticket.text: a deposit or a withdrawal with an empty description is stored, and its statement line has no text.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ledger.deposit and ledger.withdraw raise LedgerError for a description that is empty or has only whitespace; nothing is written (no journal entry, the balance does not change, no transaction stays open); a posting with a usual description works as before.

ticket.text: two more currencies, CHF and TND. The finance owner approves each change of the currency rules before it is done.

acceptanceCriteria.text: (1) EXPONENTS has CHF with 2 decimals and TND with 3 decimals; to_minor("12.34", "CHF") == 1234 and to_minor("1.234", "TND") == 1234; (2) Money.of("1.005", "CHF") and Money.of("1.2345", "TND") raise ValueError.
